# `passportsim status`

Report every instance's lifecycle, virtual time and clock.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Caps group | `core` |
| MCP tool | `passport_status` |
| HTTP route | `POST /v1/instances/{id}/commands/status` |
| Scenario step | none |
| CLI aliases | none |
| Annotations | `read_only`, `idempotent` |

## Hosts

The matrix below is the full one; this page is byte-identical on every host.

| macOS | Windows | Browser |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | yes |

## Synopsis

```text
passportsim status [instance] [--json <@file|->]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Form | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `instance` | `<instance>` | `string` | no | Instance id. |

A nested object or array is passed as one JSON document with `--json @<file>` or `--json -`; it has no flag of its own.

Input schema: [`docs/schema/commands/status.input.json`](../schema/commands/status.input.json).

## Output

Output schema: [`docs/schema/commands/status.output.json`](../schema/commands/status.output.json).
TypeScript types: `web/src/gen/commands/status.d.ts` (`StatusArgs`, `StatusResult`).

## Errors

| Code | Number |
|---|---|
| `E_USAGE` | 1 |
| `E_STATE` | 2 |

Every code is listed in [`docs/errors.md`](../errors.md).

## Examples

### List every running instance

```sh
passportsim status --json - <<'JSON'
{}
JSON
```

```powershell
@'
{}
'@ | passportsim status --json -
```

### Report one instance

```sh
passportsim status --json - <<'JSON'
{
  "instance": "p1"
}
JSON
```

```powershell
@'
{
  "instance": "p1"
}
'@ | passportsim status --json -
```
